title: OTHRYS OS functional navigation surfaces
goal: Make the Panda-style OTHRYS OS sidebar open real read-only Titans, Blocks, Models, Nodes and Oroi views backed by proven V2 data.
laws: Navigation may expose existing V2 truth only; it must not invent capabilities.
Only Hephaestus and Talos may appear as proven Titans in this mission.
Blocks must preserve proven versus stock/gated distinctions.
Nodes must display sanitized telemetry only.
Oroi may expose Factory candidate/status but cannot Accept, Reject, release, or execute.
Model view inherits V2-007B local-first/gated semantics.
No new write, shell, routing, provider, Hephaestus, Talos, Worker, or release authority.
